runners_data.name: Sanctity Of Space
runners_data.note: Unrated style (U) for John McConnell, who has sent out no runners from 24 in the last 14 days; form includes a second over 16f on good; only 5 runs at sim going (0W1P); enigmatic profile but the headgear (p) and lack of trainer activity make this one to watch cautiously rather than follow confidently.
runners_data.comment: Unplaced last time out but a runner-up three starts back shows there's ability there, still without a win in its last five starts. Has run over today's distance and going before, though a stone-cold trainer (no success in a fortnight) and a 47-day gap are the concerns.

runners_data.name: Wahraan
runners_data.note: A hold-up performer — one of several true closers redistributed into midfield because the map cannot accommodate them all at the rear; won over 18f on good, placed on soft, and has the Jessica Bedi yard in quiet form (0/6 T14); STYLE_FIT 0.92 and 62 days since last run combine to limit confidence in a strong performance.
runners_data.comment: Fifth last time out but a second five starts back points to more when conditions suit, still without a win in five outings. Has run over today's distance and going before, and a strong speed figure supports our rating of 80 here.

runners_data.name: Eastmore
runners_data.note: No jockey listed but the form is striking: 2W8P at sim going (14/15), with a win over 16f on good and three consecutive runner-up finishes; C Byrnes trainer has one recent winner (1/6 T14); prominent racer who handles this trip and this going as well as almost anything in the field — the lack of jockey information is the only cloud.
runners_data.comment: Unplaced last time out having been placed in each of his previous three starts, without a win in four outings, and our figures rate him bottom of this twenty-three-runner field. Has run over today's going before, with plenty of work still to do.

runners_data.name: Harry's Legacy
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up horse mapped to midfield because the back of the field is over-subscribed; form shows a second and third at 17f on good (2/17f, 3/14f at sim going, 0W5P); no jockey declared; 15 days since last run; the STYLE_FIT tag and the absent jockey note make this hard to back with confidence.
runners_data.comment: Fifth last time out, and a runner-up three starts back is the standout form line, still without a win in five starts. Has run over today's distance and going before, with our rating of 73 leaving him towards the rear of this field.

runners_data.name: Ben Hur
runners_data.note: A prominent racer by nature, but redistributed into midfield because so many horses want to race handy in this field; STYLE_FIT of 0.90 is the lowest in the race, meaning his chance is materially compromised if he cannot get forward early; 215 days since last run is a very long absence; won over 16f on soft and placed over 16f on heavy — talent is there, but fitness is the question.
runners_data.comment: Modest form of late - seventh, seventh and fourth - without a win in three starts, but our figures rate him fifth of twenty-three, well above his official mark. Has run over today's going before, though a lengthy 215-day absence is the major concern.

races.paceDynamic: Rock Of Ireland is the one confirmed front-runner and will attempt to dictate from the front over this 2m½f on yielding ground, but with 23 runners and a field loaded with prominent-raced types — Wackestone, Gaoth Chuil, Liam Swagger, Sign From Above, Slurricane, Louiescall, Boxing Great and Eastmore all want to race handily — Rock Of Ireland will face company rather than a solo lead, and the early pace is likely to be honest rather than dawdling. The field also contains more true hold-up horses than the map can place at the rear: Forlio, Papagei, Rakki, Wahraan and Harry's Legacy are genuine closers redistributed into midfield positions they are unlikely to naturally occupy in this race shape, meaning the backmarkers will not be as far back or as positionally pure as their labels suggest. With yielding ground confirmed for this race (earlier on the card it was good, softening through the evening) and a strong gallop set by a competitive prominent pack, the race will be run at a genuine tempo that stretches the field out. This shape strongly favours horses who travel prominently within the first five or six, conserve energy in a strongly-run race, and have the stamina to assert from two furlongs out — classically suited to front-rank stayers with proven form on soft-ish ground rather than hold-up horses who will be forced closer than ideal.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace, Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Rock Of Ireland sets a genuine clip and the prominent pack sustains pressure throughout, forcing a true stamina test.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop on yielding ground filters out the less effective stayers and rewards horses travelling fluidly in the first six; prominent types with good soft-ground form come into their own in the home straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Lead Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the large field leads to early crowding and the pace settles into a false rhythm, allowing Rock Of Ireland to coast in front unchallenged.
scenarios.body: Rock Of Ireland would get an uncontested lead and dictate a muddling gallop, converting the race into a dash for home where whoever travels best to the turn wins; prominent horses tucked in behind benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Genuine Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the honest gallop burns off the prominent pack in the final half-mile and horses from midfield finish powerfully through tired rivals.
scenarios.body: True stamina and a clean passage become the deciding factors; horses who have won on soft ground with a late run and are genuinely at home over this trip stand out.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Scrimmage Chaos, Outsider Lands
scenarios.trigger: If the 23-runner field produces significant early interference, positional shuffling mid-race, and an uneven gallop that scrambles the form book.
scenarios.body: An unexposed or lightly-raced horse finds an uncontested passage and benefits from rivals being checked or knocked out of their stride; the wide draw or rail could become decisive.

watchPoints.text: Gaoth Chuil has two recent Galway wins and the strongest similar-going record in the race (13/15, 2W8P) — if Chris Hayes gets him away cleanly in a 23-runner field he could be very hard to pass.

Eastmore's form profile (2W8P at sim going, 14/15) is quietly outstanding and the prominent style suits the expected race shape — watch for the jockey declaration and treat any confirmed booking as an upgrade.
